scope: Original-source art/layout review of all three existing stage13 static bespoke candidates. No selection, native or final acceptance.

candidates.prompt: Edit the FIRST reference into exquisite bespoke high-resolution hand-painted battle artwork for Legend of Dragoon's gorgeous AA 2026 retro remaster. SECOND reference is original source authority; original forms, topology and values control the repair. An existing dim olive-green material atlas: large upper rectangular mottled green surface with broad indistinct source value shapes, a lower row of many long thin olive tapered hanging strands against black, and neighboring top/left strips. Retain every strand count, exact position/length and all black gaps, and the upper soft value layout. Fine subtle mossy/mineral grain only inside existing shapes, no new hanging objects, leaves, trunks or scenery. Flat full-canvas atlas crop, exactly 72:112 aspect ratio; keep all edge fragments and do not crop, rotate or add perspective. Continuous restrained painterly detail, no enlarged square source pixels or smooth neural blur in textured regions. Preserve the original dim palette and shading; smooth gradient regions remain smooth. Do not invent recognizable objects, shapes, cracks, decorations, vegetation, lighting or scenery. No stronger shadows, gloss, glow, text, outlines or borders.
references: Current source-bound neural material and original decoded crop authority.
